# TSMC Files Annual Report on Form 20-F for 2025


##


Issued by: TSMC


Issued on: 2026/04/16


[TSMC Files Annual Report on Form 20-F for 2025](https://pr.tsmc.com/system/files/newspdf/attachment/e70c174b443eac6a9cebd14c729d9cf9de9e15a0/TSMC%20Files%20Annual%20Report%20on%20Form%2020-F%20for%202025_wmn.pdf)


**HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C. – Apr. 16, 2026 -** TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today filed its 2025 annual report on Form 20-F with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


The report is available at


[https://investor.tsmc.com/english/sec-filings](https://investor.tsmc.com/english/sec-filings) . Hard copies of the report are also available, free of charge, upon email request to


p_sec_service@tsmc.com .
